user.title: Connect Strava.cz
user.description: Choose how to sign in. A personal account is recommended when one email manages several canteen accounts.

personal.title: Connect a Strava.cz personal account
personal.description: Sign in with the personal-account email. All linked canteen accounts will be added automatically as separate devices.

canteen.title: Connect a canteen account
canteen.description: Use the credentials of one specific canteen account.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication was rejected. Check your credentials.
error.no_accounts: The personal account has no linked canteen accounts.
error.timeout: Strava.cz did not respond within 60 seconds. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Strava.cz account is already configured.
